data.text: [00:00]CD2 Track 2
W = Woman, J = Jack
[00:03.8]Hi, Jack. … What are you doing?
[00:06.8]Oh, it’s SimCity … have you ever played it?
[00:10.8]SimCity? `[00:12.5]No, I haven’t … and I can’t believe you’re still playing that! `[00:17.5]Aren’t you bored of it? `[00:19]It’s been around for over twenty years, hasn’t it?
[00:22.3]Well, yes … but it’s a fantastic game … really – one of the most popular computer games ever made. `[00:29]And, they bring out new versions all the time. It’s a great game …
[00:33.8]What does it involve, then? What do you have to do?
[00:37]Well, your basic task is to build a city. `[00:41]You make choices about what things you want in your city, how to keep the people in your city happy and how much to spend.
[00:49.7]What kind of things are you talking about?

[00:52]Well, you plan the whole city. `[00:55.9]You decide what different areas there are, for example, a residential area – where people live – or a commercial area, with shops and things. `[01:07.5]You can also decide where to put things like parks, cinemas, swimming pools and other facilities.
[01:15]Is it only leisure facilities?

[01:17.8]No, your city shouldn’t have too many leisure facilities. `[01:22.9]There isn’t enough space to have whatever you want – and you need to have the basic things, too. `[01:28.9]So, you decide how much to spend on basic things like roads, bus stations, hospitals and libraries.
[01:38]What about money? Can you spend as much as you want on these things?
[01:43.8]No … that’s a big part of the game – you can’t spend too much money. `[01:48.9]Most of your money comes from tax, but the people don’t want to pay too much tax.
[01:54.6]No, of course not!

[01:56]But, they want enough facilities. `[01:58.8]You know, if you don’t spend enough money on things like schools and hospitals, the workers might stop working … they might go on strike. `[02:08]And if the workers stop working, your city begins to break down. `[02:13]And with each new version, they’ve added new things; like having areas of the city which become too crowded for people to live in, and so they begin to leave. `[02:25]They’re too noisy – you know, they’re not quiet enough for some people to live in anymore.
[02:31]So, it’s basically about designing your city?
[02:35.7]Not only … I mean, there are various bad things that happen, like earthquakes and other natural disasters, and you can see how your city survives, or not …
[02:49]So, why do you think it is so popular? I mean, twenty years … that’s a long time …

[02:57]Ermm … I think it’s about choice and control … and the fact that it’s an open-ended game. `[03:05]I mean, I think SimCity is popular because it’s not about killing or destroying things. `[03:12]Too many computer games are about killing, I think.
[03:15]Yes, I agree.

[03:17]But, in SimCity, you make decisions and choices which help you in a positive way and you create your own city. `[03:25]The game is really well designed. They’ve designed it well enough to appeal to a lot of people … and … it really hold’s people’s attention for a long time. `[03:36]I think people like being in control of their own city. `[03:40]It is a virtual city, but the technology is very good, it feels very real …
